set system host-name [parameter1].explanation: Configure the host name of the device.

parameters.name: hostname
parameters.explanation: The host name of the equipment is used to identify the equipment in the network.

set interfaces [interface_name].explanation: The command `set interfaces [interface_name]` in Junos OS creates or selects a specific network interface for configuration in the device's hierarchy.

parameters.name: interface_name
parameters.explanation: The name of the interface to be disabled

unit [unit_number] disable.explanation: Disable a specific unit of an interface

parameters.name: unit_number
parameters.explanation: The unit number of the interface to be disabled

set interfaces [interface-name].explanation: The command `set interfaces [interface-name]` in Junos configures a specific network interface by defining its properties and settings within the device's configuration.

unit [unit-number] vlan-id [vlan-id].explanation: Configure VLAN ID for a specific interface unit

parameters.name: vlan-id
parameters.explanation: VLAN ID to be set for the interface unit

unit [unit_number] family [family_type].explanation: Configure an interface with a specific unit, family type, and IP address.

parameters.name: unit_number
parameters.explanation: The unit number for the interface configuration.

parameters.name: family_type
parameters.explanation: The family type for the interface configuration (e.g., inet for IPv4).

parameters.name: ip_address
parameters.explanation: The IP address and subnet mask for the interface.
